mobile.name: skeleton warrior dungeon
mobile.long_descr: The bones of a long-dead warrior rattle as it lurches toward you.
mobile.description: Empty eye sockets glow with a sickly green light. Rusted armour still clings to its yellowed bones.

mobile.name: necromancer crypt dungeon
mobile.long_descr: A gaunt figure in tattered robes weaves dark energies around itself.
mobile.description: Its flesh is pale as chalk and its fingers are stained black with necrotic magic.

mobile.name: goblin cave dungeon raider
mobile.long_descr: A vicious goblin lurks in the shadows, clutching a crude blade.
mobile.description: Small but ferocious, this goblin's hide is scarred from countless brawls.

mobile.name: cave troll dungeon
mobile.long_descr: A massive cave troll blocks the passage, its knuckles dragging the ground.
mobile.description: Its grey skin is thick as stone and its beady eyes gleam with dull malice.

mobile.name: revenant ruins dungeon
mobile.long_descr: A revenant drifts through the crumbling halls, hunger in its hollow gaze.
mobile.description: An echo of a mortal who refused to pass on, it radiates dread and cold.

mobile.name: specter ruins dungeon phantom
mobile.long_descr: A translucent form drifts through the ruined walls, wailing softly.
mobile.description: Almost invisible, the specter occasionally sharpens into a horrifying face before fading again.

mobile.name: lich crypt boss
mobile.long_descr: A towering skeleton wreathed in unholy flame blocks your path, ancient and terrible.
mobile.description: Crown and robes hang upon a skeletal frame, and eldritch fire burns in empty sockets.

mobile.name: wyvern cave boss
mobile.long_descr: A massive wyvern rears up, wings spread wide, ready to strike with venomous fury.
mobile.description: Scaled hide the colour of midnight stone, poison dripping from fangs and tail barb.

mobile.name: ancient golem ruins boss
mobile.long_descr: Cracked stone animated by primordial magic looms before you, unstoppable.
mobile.description: Carved runes glow faintly on weathered stone, holding back the eons.

mobile.name: frost wyrm mountain boss
mobile.long_descr: A dragon of ice and lightning coils in the frozen depths, ancient and terrible.
mobile.description: Blue-white scales crackle with electrical energy, and its breath mists the very air.

mobile.name: warlord stronghold boss
mobile.long_descr: A battle-scarred commander in ancient plate armour raises a massive weapon in challenge.
mobile.description: Every inch of this figure screams authority and seasoned combat. Scars crisscross exposed gauntlets.

mobile.name: phantom lord castle boss
mobile.long_descr: A spectral figure in tattered finery bars the way, voice echoing from beyond death itself.
mobile.description: Half-visible, neither fully here nor gone, it radiates malice and bitter regret.

mobile.name: treant ancient forest boss
mobile.long_descr: An enormous tree animated with primal fury towers above you, creaking with age and power.
mobile.description: Bark thick as stone, branches sharp as swords, roots writhing with ancient life.

mobile.name: alpha beast den boss
mobile.long_descr: A creature of muscle and fangs, scarred and deadly, raises its head to roar a challenge.
mobile.description: No single creature defines it — a hybrid of predator and nightmare, all claws and hunger.

mobile.name: bog hag marsh boss
mobile.long_descr: A twisted crone rises from the mire itself, dripping with filth and dark magic.
mobile.description: Rags of flesh hang from a frame of bone, and its breath reeks of stagnation.

mobile.name: sea god island boss
mobile.long_descr: A figure wreathed in waves and bioluminescent light rises from the deep, ancient and terrible.
mobile.description: Half-formed from water and coral, covered in barnacles of a thousand years.

mobile.name: dust lord plains boss
mobile.long_descr: A figure of swirling sand and ancient malice coalesces before you, ancient beyond reckoning.
mobile.description: No flesh remains — only sand held together by spite and raw will.

mobile.name: sky lord skyreach boss
mobile.long_descr: An entity of wind and light hovers before you, terrible and beautiful, lord of the high places.
mobile.description: Barely corporeal, crackling with energy, trailing clouds of mist in its wake.

mobile.name: high priest temple boss
mobile.long_descr: A robed figure wreathed in holy and profane energies stands before you, channeling forces beyond mortal ken.
mobile.description: Face hidden beneath cowls, voice echoing with unnatural harmonics, power radiating like heat.

mobile.name: warden dungeon boss
mobile.long_descr: A figure of iron and cruelty emerges from the shadows, chains dragging behind it like trophies.
mobile.description: Brutalized by countless tortures and long captivity, now twisted into something inhuman.

mobile.name: bone knight crypt sentinel
mobile.long_descr: A skeletal knight in corroded plate stalks the crypts, guarding eternal rest with undying purpose.
mobile.description: Bones fitted with rusted metal, moving with unsettling precision despite its undead nature.

mobile.name: dripping ghast cave sentinel
mobile.long_descr: A bloated creature dripping with cave slime crawls toward you, hunger blazing in its eyes.
mobile.description: Covered in moisture and fungal growth, it reeks of the deep places.

mobile.name: frost giant mountain patrol
mobile.long_descr: A massive giant of ice and stone towers above you, ready to crush intruders.
mobile.description: Skin like glacial blue ice, breath freezing the very air, eyes burning with primal cold.

mobile.name: avalanche beast mountain mob
mobile.long_descr: A creature of roaring snow and grinding ice surges forward, mindless and unstoppable.
mobile.description: Barely contained in a shape of frozen matter, constantly shifting and collapsing.

mobile.name: captain stronghold patrol
mobile.long_descr: A seasoned officer in gleaming plate mail bars the passage, sword at ready.
mobile.description: Discipline written into every line, bearing the marks of decades of command and combat.

mobile.name: noble guardian castle patrol
mobile.long_descr: An aristocratic figure in fine mail guards the halls with grim determination.
mobile.description: Bearing the scars of courtly betrayal as much as battle, eyes hard as stone.

mobile.name: shadow stalker forest patrol
mobile.long_descr: A silent figure moves between the trees, dappled with shadow and leaf.
mobile.description: Part of the forest itself, blending seamlessly with gnarled bark and twisted root.

mobile.name: sinewy stalker den mob
mobile.long_descr: A lean predator prowls forward, muscles coiled and ready, hunger in every motion.
mobile.description: Marked with the scars of a hard life, eyes reflecting no light, only hunger.

mobile.name: swamp troll marsh patrol
mobile.long_descr: A hulking figure of mud and malice rises from the mire, regenerating with primal fury.
mobile.description: Covered in silt and algae, this creature moves with surprising speed despite its mass.

mobile.name: reef keeper island patrol
mobile.long_descr: A humanoid figure wreathed in coral and barnacles emerges from the shallows.
mobile.description: Neither fully mortal nor monster, it moves with jerky, unsettling purpose.

mobile.name: prairie nomad plains patrol
mobile.long_descr: A weathered rider on spectral steed approaches, dust and wind in their wake.
mobile.description: Hardened by the open lands, carrying the look of those who hunt and are hunted.

mobile.name: wind sprite skyreach patrol
mobile.long_descr: A creature of pure wind and mist coalesces before you, form shifting and ethereal.
mobile.description: Barely visible, almost not there, yet terrifyingly real in its hunger.

mobile.name: temple dancer temple patrol
mobile.long_descr: A graceful figure moves through the halls in ritual patterns, eyes glazed with religious ecstasy.
mobile.description: Adorned with temple marks, performing an endless dance between life and death.

mobile.name: jailer dungeon patrol
mobile.long_descr: A massive, scarred figure with keys jingling at its belt stalks the corridors.
mobile.description: Disfigured by years of brutality, teeth filed to points, eyes dead as stone.

mobile.name: ghost rider plains mob
mobile.long_descr: A spectral figure on a phantom horse charges across the empty lands, lance at the ready.
mobile.description: Neither alive nor properly dead, it continues its eternal patrol above the dust.

mobile.name: sand golem plains mob
mobile.long_descr: A figure of packed earth and ancient will shambles forward, sand streaming from its joints.
mobile.description: Constantly losing grains, constantly reforming, bound by magic older than the plains.

mobile.name: cloud wraith skyreach mob
mobile.long_descr: A barely-visible spirit of cloud and wind drifts through the air, trailing vapour.
mobile.description: Almost not there, yet somehow solid when it strikes, leaving only chill in its wake.

mobile.name: lightning elemental skyreach mob
mobile.long_descr: A creature of pure electricity crackles into being, arcing with barely-contained power.
mobile.description: Raw energy barely contained in vaguely humanoid form, blindingly bright and utterly lethal.

mobile.name: test entry skyreach
mobile.long_descr: A placeholder mob for testing purposes.
mobile.description: This mob should be replaced with actual content.

mobile.name: test entry skyreach 2
mobile.long_descr: A placeholder mob for testing purposes.
mobile.description: This mob should be replaced with actual content.

mobile.name: acolyte temple mob
mobile.long_descr: A young devotee moves through the temple halls, chanting prayers to forgotten gods.
mobile.description: Shaved head marked with ritual scarification, eyes lost in religious fervor.

mobile.name: altar guardian temple mob
mobile.long_descr: A sanctified guardian stands eternal before the temple's heart, duty absolute.
mobile.description: Wrapped in vestments that have never touched mortal remains, eyes fixed on infinity.

mobile.name: tortured soul dungeon mob
mobile.long_descr: A figure wracked with pain shambles forward, broken and twisted by endless suffering.
mobile.description: Scars cover every exposed surface; the creature reeks of old blood and despair.

mobile.name: chain wraith dungeon mob
mobile.long_descr: A spectral form dragging chains of its own forging drifts through the darkness.
mobile.description: The chains are part of it now, grown into its very essence, links glowing with captive souls.

mobile.name: grave lantern wight
mobile.long_descr: A lantern-bearing wight drifts between the stones, its corpse-light cold and green.
mobile.description: The flame it carries gives off no warmth, only a sickly glow that stains the bones around it.

mobile.name: shale burrower
mobile.long_descr: A squat burrower shoves through the stone, shedding chips of shale with every step.
mobile.description: Its back is layered in slate plates, rough as a quarry wall and twice as stubborn.

mobile.name: vinebound sentinel
mobile.long_descr: A lattice of roots and driftwood bars the way, moving with slow and deliberate purpose.
mobile.description: Thorns knit together where a face should be, and damp moss clings to its bark.

mobile.name: ironbound raider
mobile.long_descr: A raider in dented mail stalks the hall, one hand always near a cracked shield.
mobile.description: Scars cross its face and old gate-rings hang from its belt like trophies from a dozen fights.

mobile.name: sunken acolyte
mobile.long_descr: A sodden acolyte shuffles forward, water dripping from the folds of its robe.
mobile.description: Algae stains its vestments, and its lips still work at half-remembered prayers.

mobile.name: stormglass hound
mobile.long_descr: A hound of frosted crystal and crackling static pads softly at the edge of sight.
mobile.description: Its coat flashes with blue-white sparks, and every breath whistles like wind through broken glass.
